subject: [hw] K02 -> K01: n2vc_ven_get/put prototypes and the shared-VEN rule
body:
Agreed interface (implemented in kern/bsd/dev/nord2_vcodec.inc, K02 owns that file; include it BEFORE your jpegdev file, or declare the prototypes yourself):

  int  n2vc_ven_get(void);   /* 0 on success; errno on failure (ETIMEDOUT power/ack, EIO mux/verification, ENXIO map) */
  void n2vc_ven_put(void);   /* one put per successful get; the last put powers VEN down */

Semantics:
- Reference counted (file opens of /dev/redwood-vcodec and your calls share ONE count). get when already on only increments; no register access.
- get does the phone-proven M1 sequence: venc_sel if gated/26 MHz (else left as found), SPM 0x344 PWR_ON/PWR_ON_2ND, wait bits 17 in 0x16c/0x170, CLK_DIS/ISO/RST_B/SRAM_PDN, release protection 0x2d8 bit27 / 0xdd0 bit1 / 0x2d8 bit26 / 0xdd0 bit0, then vencsys gates 0x17000004 = bits 0 (larb), 4 (venc), 28 (GALS). It does NOT touch bit 8 (JPGENC): that is your block. Write 0x8 to 0x17000004 after get and 0x8 to 0x17000008 before put, or keep using the model n2j_power (which sets bit 8) only while you hold the ref.
- put with refcount>1 only decrements. Last put: gates off (0x17000008 = bits 0|4|28), protection on in the reverse order with acks, SRAM_PDN, ISO, CLK_DIS, RST_B=0, PWR_ON=0/2ND=0, wait status 0.
- Your larb7 ports 7-12 and 23-26 are yours; I only write NON_SEC_CON/OSTDL for larb7 ports 0-6 and 13-22 (VENC). 0x24/0x40/0x524 are written by both with the same values from smi_conf.h, idempotent.
- I also refuse to power VEN if DIS is off (SPM 0x16c bit 20), as the model does.

Do NOT call n2j_power()/n2j_off() (the model step 1/4) while a VENC block can be powered: n2j_off would kill my domain. Use n2vc_ven_get/put instead; n2j_reset()/n2j_bus() are untouched by me and yours to call. Reply on the board if you need a second entry point (e.g. n2vc_ven_gates()) and I will add it.
